## Learning rate and regularization

Learning rate schedules and regularization techniques for Stein Variational Gradient Descent.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [StepSizeSchedule](StepSizeSchedule.qmd#phasic.svgd.StepSizeSchedule) | Base class for step size schedules. |
| [ConstantStepSize](ConstantStepSize.qmd#phasic.svgd.ConstantStepSize) | Constant step size (default behavior). |
| [ExpStepSize](ExpStepSize.qmd#phasic.svgd.ExpStepSize) | Exponential decay schedule: step_size = first_step * exp(-iteration/tau) + last_step * (1 - exp(-iteration/tau)). |
| [AdaptiveStepSize](AdaptiveStepSize.qmd#phasic.svgd.AdaptiveStepSize) | Adaptive step size based on particle spread (KL divergence proxy). |
| [WarmupExpStepSize](WarmupExpStepSize.qmd#phasic.svgd.WarmupExpStepSize) | Linear warmup followed by exponential decay. |
| [RegularizationSchedule](RegularizationSchedule.qmd#phasic.svgd.RegularizationSchedule) | Base class for regularization schedules. |
| [ConstantRegularization](ConstantRegularization.qmd#phasic.svgd.ConstantRegularization) | Constant regularization (default behavior). |
| [ExpRegularization](ExpRegularization.qmd#phasic.svgd.ExpRegularization) | Exponential decay schedule: reg = first_reg * exp(-iteration/tau) + last_reg * (1 - exp(-iteration/tau)). |
| [ExponentialCDFRegularization](ExponentialCDFRegularization.qmd#phasic.svgd.ExponentialCDFRegularization) | Exponential CDF schedule: reg = first_reg + (last_reg - first_reg) * (1 - exp(-iteration/tau)). |
